name: Reserve Manipulation and TWAP
threat_model: A caller changes synthetic AMM reserves so a consumer that trusts the instantaneous reserve ratio could read a manipulated spot price.
assumptions: This is a reserve-manipulation model: no tokens, flash loan, fee, repayment, downstream consumer, or protocol loss is modeled.
Reserve values are synthetic state updated by the example swap function.
The TWAP model uses elapsed time between observations and is not a production oracle.
invariant: A price used for valuation should not be determined solely by a transient, caller-controlled reserve change.

detector_expectations.expectation: Slither has no detector for this reserve-price economic property
